description: The source must be a string.
The source must fit the UTF-16 length bound.
The source must not contain disallowed control characters.
Nested flow, sequence, and C4 blocks must fit the depth bound.
A supported header must start the diagram.
A diagram must contain a statement.
Statements and text must satisfy the grammar and remaining semantic restrictions.
Identifiers must not match reserved words for their position.
Subgraph identifiers must not repeat, collide with declared nodes, or reference themselves within their own subgraph.
Deactivation must not make an activation depth negative.
Activation references must identify a participant introduced by a declaration, message, or note.
A participant must not be declared more than once.
Else and and branches must occur inside their respective alt or par block.
A state note must follow a declaration or transition that introduces its target.
Every relation endpoint must refer to a declared non-boundary shape.
Shape and boundary identifiers must be unique.
Every C4 boundary must contain a statement.
C4 raw text must not contain forbidden characters or entity forms.
Unwrapped bare text must not contain an ambiguous statement separator.
Every XY series must have one value for each category.
A journey score must be a safe integer within the declared bounds.
